meta.description: Tier D (startups) is sourced from job boards, not a fixed company list. Each source is re-scraped every run. Boards are checked for reachability on 2026-10-01; sources that cannot be scraped without a login / anti-bot bypass are kept here as enabled:false so the reason is recorded rather than silently dropped.

types.rss_jsonld: RSS feed(s) list posting URLs; each posting page carries schema.org JobPosting JSON-LD (description, date, location, direct ATS url).

sources.name: Startupjobs.de
sources.notes: Verified working. Feed = 100 newest DeepTech-startup jobs; ?skills=<tag> gives filtered feeds - add more feed URLs here to widen coverage.

sources.name: Wellfound (AngelList) - Germany
sources.notes: HTTP 403 to non-browser clients (bot protection). Needs a logged-in browser session / paid API; not attempted.

sources.name: honeypot.io
sources.notes: Connection failed from the dev machine, and the job board is candidate-login gated. Revisit with a logged-in session.

sources.name: EU-Startups Jobs
sources.notes: HTTP 403 to non-browser clients. Needs Playwright with a real browser profile; not attempted.

sources.name: Otta (now Welcome to the Jungle)
sources.notes: otta.com now redirects to Welcome to the Jungle, whose job search requires login. No public feed found.

sources.name: tech.eu jobs
sources.notes: jobs.tech.eu redirects to the tech.eu homepage from a plain HTTP client; the board's data endpoint was not identified. Needs investigation in a browser.
